aggressive_definition: Advanced incident prostate cancer; the abstract also analyzes fatal prostate cancer, although it frames that outcome partly as mortality.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Cox proportional hazard regression was used to calculate hazard ratios (HRs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) of total (n = 17,349), advanced (n = 2,297) and fatal (n = 804) PCa.
study_design: Prospective cohort analysis of the NIH-AARP Diet and Health Study with 14 years of follow-up.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: We used data from 159,482 participants in the NIH-AARP Diet and Health Study to investigate associations for recalled adolescent intake of red meat (unprocessed beef and processed red meat), poultry, egg, canned tuna, animal fat and animal protein at ages 12-13 years with subsequent PCa risk and mortality over 14 years of follow-up.
reason: The abstract analyzes both total incident prostate cancer and advanced incident prostate cancer in a followed cohort. Advanced PCa qualifies as aggressive incidence; PCa mortality is not treated as incident aggressive disease.
